summary: First-iteration full-stack test of GoRide. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass covering auth, role enforcement, catalog, fare estimate, full ride lifecycle (search→assigned→arrived→started→completed), wallet ₹1 deduction with both earning + platform_fee txns, admin stats/rides/users. Frontend: Playwright E2E happy-path passes — landing loads, OTP flow rejects 111111 and accepts 123456, worker can register vehicle/go online, customer books an Auto Indiranagar→Koramangala (fare ₹128.12, status 'Searching for driver'), worker accepts and advances through all states, wallet balance verified at ₹199.00 (200 → 199), admin dashboard renders stats + rides table + users table.

minor.issue: rides_today uses string-prefix comparison on ISO datetime; works for UTC today but is fragile if created_at format ever changes.

critical_code_review_comments: Auth uses raw user-id as Bearer token — fine for demo as called out, but should be flagged in any production hardening doc.

/api/rides/{rid}/status accepts 'cancelled' from worker too; valid per design but customers can also cancel after worker accepts (assigned/arrived/started). Confirm this is desired UX — current code allows it.
Frontend customer dashboard polls every 3s and worker every 3.5–4s without backoff. Acceptable for demo; consider WebSocket if scaling.
VEHICLE_TYPES is duplicated between backend (VEHICLE_CATALOG) and frontend (locations.js). Consider exposing /api/catalog as the single source the frontend renders from to avoid drift.
test_credentials: Mock OTP 123456; phones generated dynamically per run (TEST_ prefix on user names).
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates 1 customer + 1 worker + 1 admin with unique timestamp-based phone numbers and one ride that completes end-to-end. Workers seeded with default ₹200 wallet balance by backend on first OTP verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_goride.py is fully self-contained and idempotent; just run `pytest backend/tests/test_goride.py -v`. Frontend E2E happy path is verified — re-run only if main agent changes auth/ride-status flow, vehicle registration form, or admin testids (stat-rides-total / stat-revenue / admin-rides-table / admin-users-table / admin-tab-rides / admin-tab-users).
rca of the issue: No bugs found requiring RCA in this iteration.
